creator: Alexander Terp
description: From the 2026-10-24 round review, read from code (c784999a). Any Return or Esc reaching a pane published blocked starts the working override, which lasts until the screen text changes or the 5 s cap. A key that leaves the dialog in place (a dialog that ignores Return, an Esc that does not close it, a lost Return) reads working and then blocked again after the cap: a second blocked transition, which can raise a second notification or maker notice and satisfies pane wait --until blocked a second time. Right for a lost Return; noise for a dialog that ignores the key.
title: A Return or Esc that does not close a dialog reads working for 5 s, then blocked again
